$Comment: A goblin builder on every empty large lot of the temple hub, hammering at the pipe by the front of the half-built hall: a Custom anchor on the large scaffolding's Builder spot (Provider ziggfreedcommon:hub), which gives one spot per lot the scaffolding stands on, so each empty large lot has its own builder and a lot a district claims has none. Interact.Enabled false: pressing F on him opens nothing, since he is part of the place. Switch them all off in mods/ziggfreedcommon/npc-placements.json with { "Zc_Hub_Builder_Large": { "Enabled": false } }.
Name: Zc_Hub_Builder_Large
